description: A maximality rejection names the first forbidden terminator of the first reading of the ranking with maximality off, under the stage's own rule. Under late-elision, q elides U at 2 and p elides T at 1, so q's reading comes first, and the report names U at token 2. greedy would read on through p first and report T at token 1 (engine §4, §6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text p | q
%rule p y [++T] B C
%rule y A | A B
%rule q v w [++U] C
%rule v A
%rule w B | B C
